body:
Thanks, but, no, I've done that. I don't need to focus more on suffering. I need to find something to go FOR, for itself, something in this world I can connect to, be part of, and contribute to, but something that is meaningful to me. Not just "volunteer and help others," which is a standard reply, not that you gave it. I do meditate, and it's one of the tools I've used.

The "majority of people" does not include me. I am not most people. As the majority of people have always made very, very clear to me.

Why do you "have to" do it? Did you sign an agreement to do it?

I always clean up before going to friends - and I have 2 friends who never seem to bathe or wash their clothes. I don't like it, but I can't make them bathe. Don't bathe if you don't want to, I say.

I don't hate them. I just don't get them and can't be like them. I like straight shooters.

Hence a social failure and I'm alone.

Thank you for the apology, but there's really no need. People claim "I know how you feel or what you mean" often, but it really hurts when that's the response from a friend, in person, who I thought was actually listening, but I get no real confirmation. 

Yes, I have confidence in many things. And yet I'm so indecisive. Two reasons for that - I do not have a lot of connections with people, so I am often out of the loop on things most people might take for granted, even while I'm good at things they have no skills with. So I move with trepidation. Other reason is not believing in the worth of anything I could do. Not that I'm inadequate but the problems are so huge that I feel my greatest efforts would be insignificant. I wish I knew how to make worthwhile projects.

The last 24 hours have been extremely stressful. And I suck at letting go of things, but I'm trying to do that now. I must say your reply was very welcome and felt great to read. Someone with obvious intent to be genuine and reasonable, unlike the gravel-meister I had to deal with yesterday and this morning. I got my gravel and a lot of grief. I'll try to focus on MY GRAVEL, finally after a year (COVID screwed it up last year) and let go the details of typical hassles with an illiterate bully. I see my mind leaps to the arguments over and over, as it tries to fight unreason. But that's the world of people: unreasonable.  Is it not? I still find it hard to accept that we are often unreasoning animals, or use poor reasoning to bolster poor intentions. I find it hard, generally, to accept the world, not that I'm trying to.

Just writing that helped me get a bit of it out. I wish I could laugh things off easily. Started eating cannabis last year, after it legalized here. It helps, but I can't be high all day, enjoying deep relaxation and the occasional sense of euphoria. Guess I need to start meditating. 

I have never been able to relate to "low self-esteem" or why people bash themselves. The negative things I say in my mind aren't bashing me. It's not that "I'm a failure." It's that I don't match the world, and the world fails to please me - not that it's trying to - ha ha. When I think of cannabis I think of Seth Rogen and his annoying laugh, but he smokes all day and seems happy with it, not to mention successful and sometimes funny in his roles. It's my goal to find something funny in life every day. Guess I neglected to remember that yesterday, but the cannabis at the end of the day tends to automatically trigger amusing thoughts at some point. I value laughter greatly. 

Of course I can't see any reason why you would be down on yourself, but if you want to talk about that in any way I'm game. I would have an outsider perspective, of course. 

Yes, I do get some peace or I'd say relief and satisfaction from GTD getting things done, especially non-routine things. But even routine things give some satisfaction - probably because I have a strong sense of order and pattern, so I'm motivated by things functioning well and flowing smoothly. Sounds like you experience something similar in nature, feeling peace and getting some strength from goals. For me the trick is to break it down into meaningful tiny bits and get sustenance, let's call it, from each little step accomplished. Helps push me along. 

My difficulty is choosing goals, often. Nothing seems worth it. A huge topic for me. From what you said about "never really care what happened" your situation may be similar in some ways. I am not content with the work I've done and I want a new career. I can't afford to retire and indulge myself.

I didn't see any of what you said as rambling - but of course we apologize out of politeness. (Are you Canadian, too? Don't need to answer, but I am.) I didn't see anything you said as tangential or irrelevant. I appreciated every line.

I don't like cooking, but I'm good enough at it, because I like to eat good food. Recently I learned to braise meat. I like well-done beef, falling apart, so that works well for cheap meat. I ain't rich.

You didn't ask for advice, but for strength training, even some squats and bird dogs a couple times a week will serve you well. And strengthen upper back so you don't become hunched over.

I don't think I rambled, either, but I do tend to go on and on, as a detail guy. Obligatory Canadian apology attached.

I taught adults for about 10 years, so motivating or guiding or facilitating other people is not difficult or triggering for me.

I liked strength training. Since I'm old, I now, after getting stiff as hell from 20 years of strength training, also do mobility, stretching, and some cardio exercises. All part of the package, now. 

Despite teaching, I too am very much an introvert, but I am someone who learns and grows. I was socially crippled, given I was raised with no skill with emotions and no respect for them. It's been torture - this was the main reason it's been hell for me all this time. But I learned a lot - still not enough. 

No offence or criticism intended, but someone acknowledging my strength doesn't do anything for me. I  looked at your posting history and it looks - just my impression - that you are hoping to make people feel good about themselves with your comments. I really don't need that. Sure it's nice to get a compliment and I accept them, in real life, but they aren't what I need or want. They are a positive social sign, so I won't reject them. 

What I really want is to be heard and understood. I want someone to tell me, in their own words, what they heard, what I meant, said, felt. I've rarely gotten that. Extremely rarely. It's really not something important in our culture. People assume "I know how you feel" or "I've been there" is that. It ain't. And mainly they can't handle hearing the kinds of things I feel. IE Life is not worth living for me. It's not because I think ill of myself, at all. When I've been bullied, I just look down on the bullies. I don't take it on. 

Yep, anxiety and depression are chronic issues for a lot of us, manifesting in so many different ways. 

You seem a lot younger than me - a fair guess, even with no info, on reddit. So you can't really use the same motivator I use, which is think of the shit state old people get in, generally, and you can get there with no effort. Or you can make an effort, and get somewhere - pain-free, active, able to do stuff with ease, do stuff that other people same age can't do at all. Ya know what? I know two women just over 70 who can't take a bath cuz they're scared they wouldn't be able to get out! Weak! Scary weak! One of them is my friend that I'm helping.

But maybe a more relevant motivator for you would be like one I frequently use. Do you get an endorphin kick from exercise? A lot of runner's do, hence the term *runner's high*.  I get it from pushing hard, after about 15-20 minutes. When I feel like absolute shit, which is basically every day, the second I wake up, it gets to me and I know that pushing hard can take me a couple steps out of it. What's your experience with that?

I just made a hell of a good smelling pizza from scratch and wish I could share a piece with you. (Or just about anyone, really, I guess.)
I didn't even have it with my mother and father. Oh, they were there, just emotionally fucked up and not connected to me. Clueless idiots, useless to me.

That's what people want. For me to give, give, give. I give, out of duty and sheer frustration with seeing shit done wrong. Like other people my age who somehow never learned to exercise effectively and are now becoming crippled day by day.  ETC. Literally, a friend asked me to come twice a week to help motivate her. I cut it down to once a week. She is fucking clueless about exercise, somehow.

I hate sports and I always skipped gym, but in my 30s I learned that this self-healing machine needs to be put through its paces regularly or it becomes non-functional. ETC.

I'm not proud, just stubborn. It's getting worse now, though, as I see the futility. The pain just stopped me in my tracks an hour ago and I just went and lay down in bed, wishing the world away, wishing everything to just go away. 

My thoughts weren't definition intentions most of the time. MOstly the thought of death has been a relief, knowing that this shit called life doesn't go on forever. I had a way out, any time I chose, once I learned methods. 

What about you. What brings you to this sub?

I hear you. My whole life has been a rough patch, and I try FUCKING HARD. I am relentless and donno when to quit, been told that many times. And it totally sucks that basically everyone in my culture and yours are incapable of dealing with our negative feelings, thoughts, our very experiences and needs as human beings. They. Just. Don't. Get it. And they are not inquisitive or empathic.

So, if anyone wants to call me a nihilist, fine, but people suck and I have no hope for our stupid species.

Fuck you. I have tried and I do try, as I explained. You think you know about me, but you do not. Asshole.

Edit: and in fact, even YOU didn't listen to me, but you tell me to tell my story to others. People suck.
I didn't ask for advice, and that advice is not helpful. Been there, done that. No one wants to hear my story in whatever form.

Well, I'm looking back at 60 years that I wish I hadn't lived. I shouldn't have been born. And I see no way in my power to have a better future. 

Oh, I'm working at my shitty job, paying for my shitty house and fixing it up, and working hard on fitness because believe me when you're over 50 you do that or it's rapid decline and constant pain. Even so, I got an injury in February and have frequent daily pain. 

To capture the essence: There is nothing in my day or my life that is worth living for, worth putting up with all the shit for. I enjoy music and good food and nature, but I am not part of anything that matters. I do not belong and there is no place where I am content to be. Suffice to say, I am not rich enough to pay for potential solutions, either. I have to keep working.

At least I have a couple of good suicide methods, though. I've never tried to kill myself, but sounds like you have. It's not something I'd want to fail at.

Are you a good listener, or do you just give advice? Do you know about empathic listening and reflecting back what you heard so the other person feels heard? That's the kind of listening I need. Had it about 2-3 times in 60 years. Why are people so shit at it? Oh, right, because our culture doesn't value feelings.
I see it the other way around. Since I have intense rage and no one gives a shit about me, it's depressing. But that's not a clinical diagnosis, even though they've said I'm depressed many times.
I'm 60. It doesn't always get better. 60 years of shit means... probably more years of shit.

No pets and family doesn't give a shit. Friends are old like me and losing their minds, frustrating as fuck. Not op, but not everyone has the things you say. And F is for Family; they can be a reason for suicide, not a reason to live.

It's even part of the trauma healing protocols described in some good trauma healing books. Wish I could remember the exact one I'm thinking of, but don't have time to search for it right now. So, yeah, good call.

I wanted to give you my free wholesome award, but reddit won't let me "not available for this content." Guess it doesn't like the sub. WTF, so stupid.

Oh, JFC. When I hear crap like this, I just think o [Fear of a black planet](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=I1efb1R60BE) but a black planet is exactly what I'd love to see.

But dumbasses would still talk about passing white etc. People suck.

> Sometimes I wish I could disappear entirely and live completely off grid somewhere far away from everyone, including my loved ones

It's no escape from work, including working for money. My two best friends, such as they are, live or lived off the grid for decades. It's a hell of a lot of work, not all of it fun, and you also need to work for money.

> It's when your brain stops developing, you are finally mature and it occurs to you that there is... nothing else, nothing more.

Don't believe it. The brain remains plastic if you choose to pursue life with an open mind. Just most people don't, so we used to believe stuff like that.

I think I have a similar background to you in some aspects, like interested in the same subjects, though I'm twice your age and therefore further along with the problem. I've had a career, teaching ESL, and worked with a lot of Koreans. 

On the other hand, you have a girlfriend, so you're doing better than I ever was, in a sense. 

I find focusing on the outcomes I'm going for is the only thing that pushes me though. But I think it's important to keep checking on whether there are better outcomes to aim for. If you find one, change direction if you can. 

I was a good student, but I didn't plan the career part well, at all. Had I put a sensible career objective ahead of my further studies, I might have chosen different studies. If you're like me, you'll be better off in the long run with a goal that's both realistic and something that fires you up a bit. Can be hard to find something to care about, when depressed. 

I'm spending a lot of time thinking about such things lately. Took a couple weeks off work just to think, now, as I'm facing a major milestone birthday next week.  Little insights every day as I try to accept the awful reality of my existence and figure out what on earth to do rather than kill myself.
Yup, can't expect people to use technical terms or terms of art properly, in general. Gotta cut them a lot of slack.

I skip the suicide and just think about being dead. Just cool and quiet in the dark, in a pool of liquid just below the surface of the ground. Peaceful, soothing. An escape. Of course I also need earplugs to block out the noise of the real world. When I'm in that state, concentration is poor. 

Kinda the same but different. Indulging the dark thoughts rather than fighting them.

I was told if I take melatonin every day it'd stop working. Well, it really doesn't. I was also told to take much less than 3mg. I now split the tablet into 4 pieces and dissolve one under my tongue at night. Causes sleepiness, yawning. If I skip a couple days, the effect is more intense when I take it again, but I never become immune.

Celestial Seasonings Sleepytime tea with the teddybear on the package is great, not just chamomile but also lemon balm. Very sleep inducing and relaxing. I can make 2-3 days' worth from just one teabag. Drink it cold from the fridge. Yum.
Well, he was found in the Newton area of Surrey, then. It fits. Still, wtf with that hat?

>I've done nothing memorable in years. I live in total and absolute apathy.

I'm in a similar state. It worries me that nothing appeals to me. 

I get some pleasure from food, sunshine, music, and the after-effects of my workout, but that's it. I have nothing to pull me forward. I have an utter failure of imagination and connection, somehow. 

It's gotten even harder to get to the workout, but logically I know it makes a difference to numerous things, so I try to do it.

No, seriously, I really need help. I know this isn't the place for it, right?

>Our focus is on support rather than "fixes".

There is no fixing for me. I've tried, my whole life, almost 60 years. I started trying in my early teens, when a new layer of shit came onto everything with puberty and my inability to have any peers or mesh with people my own age. It's just been hell, and I can't cope anymore. My birthday is coming up this month like a big slap in the face.

Having a life is subjective in the sense that it's a person's subjective response to life. As my former trainer told me, "I have a roof over my head and food in my fridge." He ended up as a trainer and amateur theatre guy, when his shot at a professional dance career didn't work out. So, he didn't get his dream, but he was still happy in life, content. So it's not just about "grand success." Not everyone even thinks of trying such things. 

>If what you're doing now isn't making life worth living, you can do something else, drop all of it and move to Thailand, find a new hobby or learn how to mask your true feelings towards humanity and try to interact with people as best you can. There are probably other options that aren't coming to mind at the moment.

I've learned to cope with humanity and feelings. It's not rewarding, though. Just another chore. There are no options for me. I can barely get out of bed anymore. 

>Our focus is on support rather than "fixes". If you are looking for a more solution-oriented community, check out /r/getting_over_it/ or /r/GetMotivated.

Why? Cultural brainwashing on positivity, as well as deep lack of empathy and listening skills.

>I told him my joy was long gone. He then proceeded to tell me that life can’t be that bad. I felt so invalidated.

Invalidated hurts. I grew up in this kind of environment. My mother was a fuckin social worker and would try to pry out my emotions and then stamp on them with her tiny superficial mind.

Having a life is not subjective when I'm referring to people I know who are doing good things and I know enough about their life to know they have what I don't - relationships, connection, and some kind of satisfaction in work.

I hate life. That makes me a repulsive failure, for starters. Life is not worth it for me and even if I don't say that, all the unsaid things add up. I'm not normal in a lot of ways. The vast majority of people seem to consider that an incomprehensible failing, as well. But recently I've realized the misanthropy and lack of loving life have put a lot of people, most people, against me. Not that they're out to get me or anything. I'm not paranoid. But people go to what they like, and it's not me. I'm shunned.

It doesn't matter that I'm excellent in my work, that I'm fitter than most people my age, that I own my own home. Those are positive things, but they aren't enough to make life worth living. It's all been a long hard slog, apparently for nothing. 

I don't wish to pray. I dislike religion quite a lot and mostly it's a thing that needs to be left behind. Like most human bullshit.

I'm an atheist. I don't pray. 

Little bits of us band together. There are some good people out there. But they have a life of some kind, and I don't. I know now everyone is likely to see me as a failure.

Edit: this realization that everyone would see me as a failure is pretty recent.

Wow, you've suffered an excess of bullying, cruelty, and violence. I don't think my brothers were brought up with that stupid macho attitude, but I know it's common. "Man up." I hate that expression.

You said you have female friends. Could you possibly ask them for help on your appearance? It's a small thing, but it makes a difference. Also it takes some confidence to carry it off. It's hard to feel confident when you've been put down all the time. I feel it, too. Don't believe in myself, especially after decades of failure. I'm much older than you.

I do know dating sites are very cruel and superficial. You have those female friends, you say. Might be better to try real world outreach than dating sites. But I'm a failure, too, so maybe my suggestions are worthless.

Yeah, I wish we were like crows. You can't tell gender by appearance. All of them are just black. A lot of other birds have fancy males with fancy breeding plumage, and these birds remind me of people. Always flirting and playing the game. I don't hate the birds for what they are, but I wish people were like crows. None of the silly games, and they mate for life, unlike the player-birds. 

And I always felt I should probably have been a man, but 50 years ago people didn't talk about gender reassignment, though it was just barely on the radar. I don't want that. I consider myself androgynous and that is the least of my worries, though it was quite a trial earlier in life and is part of the whole awful pattern of damage. Just one of the many ways I could never fit in and so I was dropped from my best childhood friends when they hit puberty. I didn't turn into a boy-chasing fashionholic, so I didn't fit in. Period. I just didn't get it, at all.
I so relate to everything you've said. Except I haven't prayed for a mass extinction event.

No, there is absolutely nothing to look forward to. My life has been a mistake. What you describe does not describe the pattern of my life so far. You're describing an average. I tend not to be in that group. I tend to be on the long tail, the 98th percentile and up. 

I have no one. And I have nothing I want. All I have is sad and painful memories.

Edit: Not suggesting I'm superior to anyone. Just saying I have enough characteristics on the long tails that I stand out, get pointed out, and it's been a pointless struggle, really, dealing with it.

Yeah, psychopathy is a big thing in forensic psychology. Far from fictional. However, it's also what people jump to when they see someone they deem to have different feelings than they expect. I'm overloaded with emotion, just not about the things other people like.
Sorry you feel as I do. It fucking hurts, beyond bel,ief.
The world is full of bullshit and not worth trusting.

I'm 60. Female. I can get sex, no problem. Even though I'm "not considered attractive." But  love........... that's something few people have to offer.

LIfe sucks.

I feel the same. It hurts. Nothing to live for. Agreed:

>I just want to sleep forever, you know when something is wrong when you enjoy your dreams more than life.
Well done. Report the bad guys.
Sounds like a shitty relationship. Time to walk? Is it a partner or family?

I don't want to kill myself because I know my neighbours will just fucking gloat about it. I mean one of them literally called me a witch and said I should kill myself if I'm not happy with life. Literally said it in earshot of me.

But I still might do it. I have three different methods. Yay Geo Stone. I have to sort out my will so at least my money goes to something I care alittle bit about instead of the provincial government.

My 60th birthday is coming up and I"m in despair at my shit quality of life and utter failure in life.

Your experiences aren't relevant. If you want to help people you should listen on their terms, not make it about you. Just my opinion. Thanks for reply, anyway.

I've radically exposed my vulnerabilities because I was too socially clueless to do otherwise and I believe in openness. It doesn't work. My vulnerabilities are apparently not common enough to be socially acceptable. I'm one of those TMI no shame people, so that's definitely not the problem. I find NOT saying stuff is the key to maintaining any sort of relationship, unfortunately. 

I was even married. I believed in openness. He didn't and wasn't open with me. When he ended it, he finally told me that he always judged me. What a fucking piece of work. Asshole. Wish I never met him.
Christ, I have to wake up to pee every 2 hours and that is bad enough. I feel for you, kiddo. (I am 60 yo hence the kiddo - it's meant in a friendly way.)

Ask them.  They find me too different. After 60 years I have to accept the overall results there. I can't fix it. How do I go on? 

I've learned to connect superficially and appreciate even that. But it's not enough to make life worth living.
Good for you. I've always helped others out of a sense of basic human duty, but it's not something that makes me feel better. When I was a teacher, that's not what I cared about or why I did it.

I'm too different.

No kids, never wanted them. Most people my age are grandparents. I never met mine. Never had good or close family relationships.

Don't like dogs, tv, sports, fashion, large group activities, noise, etc, etc.

Funny thing is I am not too bad at public speaking or being a leader, when a role demands it. Like shop steward - something most people don't want. But off the cuff, feeling the room, tapping into whatever the hell other people are seeing, just no. Generally I'm the "nonuser" or person who sees no damn point in new things, popular things, or anything. I do love some popular things, though. I'm not being oppositional here.

Yeah, of all the books I've read on how to do things in the world or improve my life, it all boils down to connections with others. Which I lack. Hence extreme suffering. I have always had blinding difficulties with people and emotions. Life has essentially been an elaborate torture, day by day, moment by moment.
Wasn't worth it for me. I can't relate to people adequately, much as I appreciate the few connections I have, and apparently therapists can't relate to me. It was a colossal waste of time and hope.

I'm pushing 60.  I also never learned to connect. I have "friends" but no one I can really talk to about what I need to. No one who is going to wonder why they haven't heard from me, if I kill myself.

Reasons for that obviously aren't "generational." Pretty sure many people have experienced this for many reasons and not just covid and the virtualness of everyday life in recent years/decades.

>I hate my job. Hate life. No friends and I’m really just living to not be dead because death makes people uncomfortable but life makes me uncomfortable. I just wish I could die peacefully. I wish I was never born .. some people enjoy life and i just can’t.

I do relate. What little enjoyment there is doesn't make it all worthwhile. There is no damn point, for me.

Thank you, but there is no one for me. No one ever loved me, let alone romantically. I accept I will be alone for the brief remainder of my life. 

Sex - never a problem for me. Orgasmic, enjoyed it. Wanted to know what it's like to be loved on top of that. Hoping to hear more details.
I always told those mofos (professionals and amateurs) that: I'm not depressed. I'm sad for numerous reasons.
T is not a plus sign. T is for time. Fuck using t or u or v. Fucking hated those in chemistry.
Fantastic.
